$comment: Units of each currency per 1 USD, entered by hand (YOY-149 AC-7; NG-2: no rate vendor, no automatic refresh). Source: ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates of 2026-10-02 (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/eurofxref-daily.xml), converted to per-USD (rate / USD rate) and rounded to 3 decimals (YOY-150 AC-13). A stated price cap in a currency other than the catalog's is converted through USD. A pair with either side missing leaves the number unapplied. Update asOf and the source with every edit.
